summary: @bydiorama/ui 0.1.0 is on npm, so install instructions use `npx @bydiorama/ui …` from inside the app instead of running the CLI from a bydiorama/ui checkout: the README quick start, theme-zero-css, eslint-preset and sync, and the visual-review skill's setup step (`npx @bydiorama/ui add visual-diff`). The README names the components.json `registries` entry the CLI reads, and the --revision fallback for when GitHub's anonymous API limit answers 403.
